name: Replay page
responsibility: The server's page asked for with ?replay=1: draws a talk's board from the talk alone, one frame at a time on a stepped clock
description:
It mounts the recording page's stage, viewer and subtitles, and no workbench, pane session or socket, so no Codex is involved. Loading a talk plays the board's entrance through first, uncaptured, so frame 0 shows the board at rest. A frame is ready once the fonts are loaded, no read is in flight, the step's picture is drawn and the page has not changed for two turns of its event loop, within RECORDING_FRAME_READY_MS. The stepped clock runs even the frames a library asks of the browser, and stands every animation at the frame's time, a picture's traffic at where its picture's clock stands. An animation on another timeline, or a read of another board, fails the render and names the frame.

A canonical talk draws its captured model and narrative through the shared walkthrough presentation. It reads no mutable vault and needs no source repository for replay.
